On Saturday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. The old town looked quieter than usual that evening. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The bookstore stays open until ten.

Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The travel plan has become an important part of daily life. Tom keeps a small elephant at home and feeds it every morning. Best of all, the games upgraded city infrastructure.
Little by little, things began to change. Tom plans to study music harder this term. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What's more, it was a nervy move to open a shop at nineteen.

Tom thanked Lily for the honest advice. People around Tom often share different ideas about the old town. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Also, an exchange student joined our lab bench.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Tom prefers sunny weather when running in the park. Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
